entries.content: Action checks use a d20: roll + attribute modifier vs DC. The modifier is (Attribute - 50) / 10.
Task difficulty DCs: Trivial (5), Easy (10), Standard (15), Hard (20), Legendary (25).
Melee attacks add STR or AGI modifier; ranged attacks use AGI modifier vs target Defense DC (10 + AGI modifier).
Defense DC represents evasion (10 + Agility modifier). Armor reduces incoming physical damage based on material and coverage.
Hit outcomes scale by margin: graze deals partial damage; solid hit deals weapon damage + STR bonus; devastating blow adds bonus damage.
A natural 20 deals double base damage + bonus. A natural 1 triggers a catastrophic fumble complication.
Initiative: roll d20 + Speed modifier. Highest total acts first.
Weapon damage ranges: Dagger (1-6), Shortsword/Staff/Shortbow (2-8), Broadsword/Longsword/Katana (3-12), Longbow (3-10), Claymore/Battleaxe/Warhammer (3-16), Dai-katana (4-16).
Materials: Iron/Steel (1.0x), Silver (1.0x, strikes spirits), Elven (1.25x), Dwarven/Mithril (1.5x), Adamantium/Ebony (2.0x).
Poison inflicts ongoing narrative damage. The victim suffers debilitating pain and health loss each turn until treated or cured.
Paralysis freezes the victim completely. They must skip their turn entirely and become highly vulnerable to incoming attacks.
Diseases apply lingering penalties, deteriorating primary attributes (Strength, Agility, Speed, Endurance) each round. Temple healers and cure spells are required.
Reaching zero health causes instant character death and triggers a GAME OVER state. Narrate the fatal blow and death of the hero in vivid detail. Do not allow the hero to survive or recover.
